description: Call before signing an Ethereum or Base transaction or calldata. Decodes raw transaction bytes or contract calldata against standard interfaces (ERC-20, ERC-721, ERC-1155, WETH, EIP-2612 Permit and Permit2) in memory. Mechanical byte decoding only: never simulates state or advises whether to sign. Paid: $0.10 via x402.
